products.name: Palantir AIP
products.note: Enterprise AI platform; Ontology-based governance; defense/intel focus; high-stakes decision influence

profile_text.body:
Palantir is a public software company founded in 2003 and headquartered in Palo Alto, trading on public markets under the ticker PLTR (CIK 0001321655). The company describes itself as building software that empowers organizations to effectively integrate their data, decisions, and operations, positioning its work as the foundational software of tomorrow.

Its primary tracked AI product is Palantir AIP, an enterprise AI platform that uses an Ontology-based governance approach and is oriented toward defense, intelligence, and high-stakes decision-making contexts. The platform is designed to connect data and operational workflows within large organizations, with particular emphasis on environments where consequential decisions are made.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, or SEC filing details beyond the company's basic public registration are present in the available data.
